accept: The hotter the Earth gets, the higher sea levels rise.
The hotter the Earth gets, the higher the sea levels rise.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [17–18] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① Neither Rachel nor I have a pet.
② The bird was as smaller as my hand.
③ The new laptop is twice as fast as the old one.
④ He ate a piece of cake made yesterday.
⑤ I hope that she likes my present.
choices: Neither Rachel nor I have a pet.
The bird was as smaller as my hand.
The new laptop is twice as fast as the old one.
He ate a piece of cake made yesterday.
I hope that she likes my present.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [17–18] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① Keep the volume as low as possible.
② He came too late for the appointment.
③ James is the most faster runner on our team.
④ Although he missed the bus, he was not late for school.
⑤ The flight was canceled because the weather was foggy.
choices: Keep the volume as low as possible.
He came too late for the appointment.
James is the most faster runner on our team.
Although he missed the bus, he was not late for school.
The flight was canceled because the weather was foggy.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [19] 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① He <u>suddenly</u> grabbed my arm.
② Everyone <u>quickly</u> moved the boxes.
③ Someone was looking at me <u>suspiciously</u>.
④ <u>Finally</u>, the long trip ended.
⑤ My friend Mina is very <u>friendly</u>.
choices: He <u>suddenly</u> grabbed my arm.
Everyone <u>quickly</u> moved the boxes.
Someone was looking at me <u>suspiciously</u>.
<u>Finally</u>, the long trip ended.
My friend Mina is very <u>friendly</u>.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [20] 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 서로 다른 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① She said that she didn't lie.
= She said she didn't lie.
② Come home as soon as you can.
= Come home as soon as possible.
③ My younger brother is fatter than my dad.
= My dad is not as fat as my younger brother.
④ The glove is not mine. It is on the floor.
= The glove which is not mine is on the floor.
⑤ I bought a new board game. It is sold only online.
= I bought a new board game that is sold only online.
choices:
She said that she didn't lie.
= She said she didn't lie.

Come home as soon as you can.
= Come home as soon as possible.

My younger brother is fatter than my dad.
= My dad is not as fat as my younger brother.

The glove is not mine. It is on the floor.
= The glove which is not mine is on the floor.

I bought a new board game. It is sold only online.
= I bought a new board game that is sold only online.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [21] 다음 중 that을 생략할 수 없는 문장을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① I realized <u>that</u> I didn't set the alarm.
② Who is that man <u>that</u> is waving at us?
③ The pizza <u>that</u> we ordered was delivered.
④ Did you hear <u>that</u> Rosy lost her dog yesterday?
⑤ Kate takes the yoga class <u>that</u> I recommended recently.
choices: I realized <u>that</u> I didn't set the alarm.
Who is that man <u>that</u> is waving at us?
The pizza <u>that</u> we ordered was delivered.
Did you hear <u>that</u> Rosy lost her dog yesterday?
Kate takes the yoga class <u>that</u> I recommended recently.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [22] 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:

B: Of course. Go straight and turn left at the second corner.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [23] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
A: Paul, is your father a cook?
B: No. He is a writer, not a cook. But he is interested in both writing (A) ______ (B) ______.
① or — cook
② or — cooking
③ and — cooking
④ and — cook
⑤ but — cooking

or — cooking
and — cooking

items.sectionInstructionKo: [24] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 대화를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① A: This bakery sells a lot of cheesecakes. Let's try the cheesecake first.
B: Good idea.
② A: How is the service at that restaurant?
B: It's much better than that of the restaurant next to it.
③ A: The subway that broke down is running again.
B: Luckily, I can go home early.
④ A: Look at the child crying over there.
B: Let's give him some help.
⑤ A: Who is this person next to you in the photo?
B: He is my nephew. He is a seven-years-old boy.
choices:
A: This bakery sells a lot of cheesecakes. Let's try the cheesecake first.
B: Good idea.

A: How is the service at that restaurant?
B: It's much better than that of the restaurant next to it.

A: The subway that broke down is running again.
B: Luckily, I can go home early.

A: Look at the child crying over there.
B: Let's give him some help.

A: Who is this person next to you in the photo?
B: He is my nephew. He is a seven-years-old boy.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [27] 다음 대화에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분 두 군데를 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 어법에 맞지 않은 부분을 고친 말만 쓰세요.
items.promptEn:
틀린 두 곳을 위에서부터 고친 말만 쓰세요. ⓑ의 which를 빼려면 delete라고 쓰세요.
A: Mark, I heard ⓑ which you won first place in the quiz contest. Congratulations!
B: Thanks, Henry. I prepared a lot, and I was lucky, too. I was surprised at my high score.
A: You must be ⓓ smartest boy in our class. Is there another contest you want to enter?
B: Yes. It will be held in winter. I hope I win the contest as well.
